import hashlib, json, re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/uk-data-reconciliation-lot')
source = root / 'raw/tender-feed.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == 'bce526db75eb233a34dc2e0e9facfa98e42554d555774934b6c20e6f5414ba25'
package = json.loads(raw)
releases = package['releases']
cutoff = datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-25T13:30:26+00:00')
pattern = re.compile(r'\b(?:spreadsheet|reconcil\w*|data quality|data cleans\w*|data validat\w*|data audit|csv)\b', re.I)
rows = []
for release in releases:
    tender = release.get('tender') or {}
    deadline = (tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate')
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(deadline.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        deadline_state = 'after_snapshot' if parsed > cutoff else 'elapsed_at_snapshot'
    except (AttributeError, ValueError, TypeError):
        deadline_state = 'unknown'
    matches = []
    for scope in [tender, *(tender.get('lots') or [])]:
        for field in ('title', 'description'):
            text = scope.get(field) or ''
            match = pattern.search(text)
            if match:
                matches.append({'scope_id': scope.get('id'), 'field': field, 'excerpt': text[max(0, match.start()-90):match.end()+110]})
    rows.append({'release_id': release.get('id'), 'ocid': release.get('ocid'), 'release_date': release.get('date'), 'tags': release.get('tag'), 'notice_status': tender.get('status'), 'title': tender.get('title'), 'tender_deadline': deadline, 'deadline_state': deadline_state, 'matches': matches})
lead_ids = [row['release_id'] for row in rows if row['matches'] and row['deadline_state'] != 'elapsed_at_snapshot']
result = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': digest, 'deadline_comparison_at': cutoff.isoformat(), 'release_count': len(rows), 'lead_ids_in_feed_order': lead_ids, 'releases': rows, 'coverage': 'One captured feed page. Keywords flag leads only. Verify lot deadlines, standalone scope, eligibility, acceptance and response route in the original notice. Recheck deadline at time of review.'}
out = root / 'director-feed-screen.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'release_count': len(rows), 'lead_ids_in_feed_order': lead_ids, 'artifact': str(out)}))
